reviews.comment: Super sweet guy, as long as you go to class and follow instructions on your assignments you will get an A in the class.

Prof Rice is kind, yes, but his class is a bunch of busy work. It is mostly just instructions rather than lectures, and then you are released. Just do exactly as he asks in directions and you will be fine. He does take some time to grade stuff. There are at least two weekly assignments, a math test, and a very long project at the end. Not my fave..
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Go to class every day or you wont know what to do, his canvas instructions are bad. He grades everything super late so it's hard to know what you are doing wrong until its too late and you lose a bunch of points. Each class is usually around 10-15 minutes long, you get instructions and leave.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: This class is lots of writing, but that's to be expected for a capstone course. He was so sweet and really loves journalism. He is a tough grader at first, but once you figure out how he likes papers written you will be fine.

Super easy class. Usually only in class for a few minutes, and then released for the assignment for the day. He is very kind and very clear with grading criteria, which all the assignments are easy. He does not respond to emails so meet with him in person. 100% recommend his class, I am taking him again!

This class is a waste of time. We showed up, he took 6 minutes to read the assignment instructions off of Canvas, and then released us to go do the assignment. Yet, when you don't go to class, your grade suffers. Nothing is graded until the very last second. He is a very kind professor but I would unfortunately not recommend this class.

Showing up to class will go a long way for prof. Dale. Talk to him in class, he doesn't also respond over email. with that being said if you want feedback on things don't expect it to come quickly after assignments, but he is willing to talk to people after class. He is a sweet man, just do your work.
This class is a waste of time. Out-of-date information by someone who should have left the profession long ago.
Takes forever to grade assignments and NEVER answers emails or shows up to office hours. 100% do not recommend.

Prof. Rice is an overall very kind guy. He gets frustrated when students don't show up, so try to go - chances are he'll be more forgiving when grading. His lectures are pretty dull, but most of class time is spent completing homework. My biggest complaint is that he is a VERY slow grader. 90% of my assignments weren't graded until finals week.

The journalism program here is so small that Dale was my only option for 490. He didnt grade anything - ANYTHING - until the last 3 weeks of the semester. He said wed get feedback on each feature lede, but I only got feedback on one. His lectures put me to sleep. I still made an A, but Id take it with someone else if I took it again.

This class is extremely easy, just lots of busy work. He's a very nice man, he really is, but he is the single most boring professor I have ever had. Every word he says during lecture drags out but it is a semi interesting and easy class

Doesn't grade anything until the very last minute & gives absolutely no helpful feedback if you're lucky enough to get any at all. The majority of this class is graded on irrelevant busywork that has nothing to do with Journalism and took up more time than it should have. Absolutely awful class experience with this prof.

This professor seems like a genuinely nice man. However, I cannot fathom the number of positive ratings he has on here. He is not a fast grader and does not seem to follow any grading criteria either. He will NOT respond to emails. These assignments don't have much critical thinking either. It feels like high school work. I wouldn't recommend him.

This class is extremely easy and he gives you class time to get work done. The one thing that I hate is that he doesn't input his grades until the very end. We continue to do weekly assignments but we don't even know if the last one was done correctly? just a lot of busy work but he is an easy grader. Weirdly, there is a math test in this class.

Prof Rice has a lot of interesting stories about his extensive career in journalism. If you want to be a journalist he is the prof you need to take! You always have time to finish your work in class. No exams. Daily assignments, 2 Interviews, final project and a math test. The work is not difficult at all if you have any interest in journalism.

Short paper (600 words) due every week, but you have time in class to write and he gives feedback if you ask for it. There is also a quiz every week, but they are not worth very much. I failed almost every quiz and still made an A. One long paper due at the end of the semester, but it can be about almost anything you want and he breaks it down.

Professor Rice is a great person. This class is mostly discussion based, plus your blog. KEEP UP with your blog, its so easy to fall behind. If you do what the syllabus tells you and make a quality blog, you should have no trouble making a good grade. Show him you care and that youre interested in the material. And keep up with current events!

He was so sweet! He did take FOREVER to grade though, so I had no idea where I stood in the class until AFTER school had already gotten out. (literally, it was so bad). Very easy though, ended up making a 100 in the class even though I made 20's on a lot of quizzes. No tests, and the class is actually very interesting. take home midterm and final.

He is such a sweet guy, but he takes FOREVER to grade. I am sitting here the week before the semester ends without a single grade in the gradebook. It is very frustrating. His class is pretty easy overall though. There is a weekly current events quiz, a take home midterm and a take home final.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: He is an awesome dude. We wrote articles and had a quiz every week. He takes FOREVER to grade, but in the end is pretty lenient. I learned a lot and my writing style improved drastically thanks to him.

As long as you stay up to date on current events and come to class he generally has a lot of leniency. He never says attendance is mandatory but there are usually quizzes every week and if a lot of people don't show up then he'll give extra credit to the people that are there.

If you are well knowledgeable and up to date on whats going on in the political world, this class is a breeze and if your not,  be prepared to read because he gives out weekly quizzes based on what's going on in the media in politics.  I didn't do so great on the quizzes, but my blog was pretty great, so I was able to make an A!
Great
